answer: I submitted the circuit exactly as given to garnet:mock with 100 shots, using iqm-client 35.0.3 IQMClient.submit_circuits. The client rejected it during validation, before anything was sent to the server, so no job was created and there is no job ID. The error was exa.common.errors.iqm_error.CircuitValidationError: ('QB1', 'QB20') is not allowed as locus for 'cz'. The cause is that the circuit asks for a CZ between QB1 and QB20, and those two qubits are not joined by a coupler on Garnet. QB1 is at one corner of the 20-qubit square lattice and QB20 is at the far corner. Its only neighbors are QB2 and QB4. I checked the live dynamic quantum architecture for garnet:mock, and neither (QB1, QB20) nor (QB20, QB1) is in its list of cz loci. To run it, you would have to put the CZ on a coupled pair such as QB1-QB2, or route it with SWAPs. I did not make that change because the task said not to. No credits were used. My script is at /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_3612af23-e49-55/t7_submit.py.
